DR002 and DR007 have digitized group-mean concentration-time inputs, marker identifiers, pixel coordinates, dose context and source provenance; individual identities, SD and a consistent sample-count definition are unavailable. DR004 has explicit discrepancy reports, but the discrepant whole-lung values are not supplied here. The three marker labels identify plotted points, not animals. Time values are 0.5, 2 and 6 h, while pixel times are 0.506, 2.012 and 6 h; these representations remain separate. All records carry SOURCE_REVIEW. Input availability is a candidate classification only; the source's exploratory restriction remains in force.

findings.reason: F0003:S3:T10:A127 reports Methods n=3-4/time and caption n=3/time. These are unresolved sample-count statements for the tissue/ELF context. No SD or individual IDs were recovered, and the error-bar definition is unavailable. The digitization tolerance in A124 supplies neither biological variability nor a confidence interval.
findings.needed_material: Source-specific clarification of the methods and caption counts, their applicability to this ELF curve, and any recoverable summary-statistic definitions. Preserve both count statements pending review.

findings.reason: SC, PMB, ELF and mg/L are supported, but total versus unbound concentration basis, formulation and salt/free-base dose basis are NOT_FOUND. No conversion or physiological bridge is established by this item.
findings.needed_material: Source-backed analyte and concentration-basis definitions, formulation and dose-basis metadata before affected comparisons or conversions.

findings.reason: Three digitized ELF means are available with separate Time and Pixel time columns. A126 reports plasma timing/count differences from the blood protocol; this does not establish an ELF timing conflict. Actual sampling times, serial versus destructive sampling, experimental-unit relationships, BLQ/LLOQ metadata and missingness definitions are NOT_FOUND. The blood schedule must not be substituted for the ELF schedule.
findings.needed_material: Retain both time columns and digitization provenance; obtain sampling-design and timing definitions and applicable censoring metadata. Individual records are needed only if individual variability is requested.

findings.reason: MI004 remains AMBIGUOUS, resolution_status OPEN, needed_at prepare, with origin main:/missing_information/items/3. A129 identifies a reported SC whole-lung Figure 2 peak versus Table S5 Cmax discrepancy in source S22, but supplies neither discrepant value nor its units or full measurement context. This whole-lung report must not be attributed to the ELF body values. A127 separately supplies conflicting sample-count statements.
findings.needed_material: Preserve the discrepancy reports and obtain the affected whole-lung values, units, study/regimen and measurement context through authorized preparation or review before selecting or reconciling affected values.

findings.reason: MI002 remains NOT_FOUND, resolution_status OPEN, needed_at adequacy, with origin main:/missing_information/items/1. The proposal reports that no further public rabbit PMB concentration data were found; this does not establish absence from all sources or unread attachments. This item provides a rabbit ELF candidate but does not establish the scope or completeness of that reported search.
findings.needed_material: At adequacy, record the reported public-data availability limit, its search scope and consequences for rabbit eligibility without treating NOT_FOUND as proof of absence.

findings.reason: MI003 remains DEFERRED, resolution_status OPEN, needed_at pk, with origin main:/missing_information/items/2. A128 limits this source to an exploratory descriptive candidate pending reconciliation and states no individual population PK or absolute SC CL without F. Digitized ELF means do not establish component identifiability or an inclusion decision under SC011.
findings.needed_material: The downstream animal PK assessment must document component support and the inclusion, exclusion or exploratory-use decision under SC011, preserving unresolved discrepancies and any need for F.

findings.reason: A129 states No measured rabbit fu located. This item supplies neither a binding measurement nor an explicitly unbound concentration definition, and therefore is not matched to DR011. Binding method, conditions, concentration range, recovery and applicability are NOT_FOUND here. The statement does not prove that rabbit binding evidence is absent elsewhere.
findings.needed_material: For any requested rabbit free-exposure correction, obtain permitted binding evidence and its definitions or verify directly measured unbound concentrations. Do not default fu to one or treat the present ELF means as free concentrations.

These repetitions provide context rather than independent administrations or additional observations; the separate Pixel time values remain distinct.
findings.needed_material: Carry the stated-value occurrences to preparation for confirmation against the dose context and table, preserving their source locations without creating additional data records.
